capabilities: Catalogue books by author and title parsed from file names
Open a book in the PDF viewer with its notes beside it
Search text in one book or across the whole library
Show a reference desk of newest, recent and flagged books
Maintain per-book Markdown notes with autosave and a conflict guard
disambiguation: Not an ebook reader or PDF annotator; it catalogues books and opens them in Obsidian's PDF viewer, and it does not save PDF highlights.
extras: Desktop only. Notes live outside the vault and are edited in a plain text box rather than Obsidian's Markdown editor. Whole-library search needs a long background index build that can take hours and several GB of local storage.
problem: Large PDF libraries in a vault have no fast keyboard way to find a book, keep notes beside it, or search inside the books themselves.

relations.evidence: By default it opens Rogetta, but any dictionary, thesaurus or translation page works
The layout is modelled on the old AAAARG website

summary: Keyboard-first catalogue for a vault of PDFs, with per-book notes, full-text search and a reference desk of new and flagged books.
